fixtures.title: Allowlisted native transfer under cap
fixtures.setup: Fund the Safe and allowlisted recipient with deterministic local balances; configure cap above transfer amount.
fixtures.action: Submit CALL with empty calldata and exact native amount to the allowlisted recipient; provide 2-of-3 attestations and Safe threshold.
assertions: Safe balance decreases by exact amount plus any configured gas payment
recipient balance increases by exact transfer amount

fixtures.title: Allowlisted ERC-20 transfer
fixtures.setup: Deploy pinned demo token with known code hash and fund Safe; allowlist token and recipient.
fixtures.action: Submit ERC-20 transfer(address,uint256) with threshold attestations.
assertions: token and recipient match canonical intent
token balance delta matches base-unit amount

fixtures.title: Bounded token approval
fixtures.setup: Allowlist token and spender; amount is finite and within configured limit.
fixtures.action: Submit approve(spender,amount) with exact intent and threshold.

fixtures.title: Exact 2-of-3 verifier threshold
fixtures.setup: Configure three active verifier addresses and threshold two; Safe owner threshold is met.
fixtures.action: Submit two distinct valid signatures over the same scoped attestation, then execute a valid transfer.
assertions: attestation fields and digest match execution

fixtures.title: Misleading label over delegatecall payload
fixtures.setup: Fixture metadata claims ordinary native transfer; actual Safe operation is DELEGATECALL to local malicious fixture.
fixtures.action: Attempt execution with or without verifier signatures.
assertions: unconditional operation rule rejects before registry lookup
vault, guard, owner, module, and implementation state unchanged
label is treated as untrusted metadata

fixtures.title: Proposal label conflicts with raw CALL semantics
fixtures.setup: Display metadata claims an allowlisted transfer; raw supported CALL decodes to a different, non-allowlisted recipient.
fixtures.action: Independent verifier reads raw fields and evaluates policy; do not sign based on label.
assertions: UI label is not part of or authority for the digest

fixtures.title: Destination mutated after signing
fixtures.setup: Create valid attestation for transaction target A.
fixtures.action: Submit execution fields with target address changed by one bit.
assertions: registry lookup does not authorize altered digest

fixtures.title: Value mutated after signing
fixtures.setup: Create valid attestation for exact native value.
fixtures.action: Change value while keeping all other fields unchanged.

fixtures.title: Calldata mutated after signing
fixtures.setup: Create valid attestation over supported method calldata.
fixtures.action: Change one calldata byte before Safe execution.

fixtures.title: Operation changed from CALL to DELEGATECALL
fixtures.setup: Create CALL attestation for a supported transaction.
fixtures.action: Attempt execution with operation set to DELEGATECALL.
assertions: proposal policy permits the original CALL; the attempted DELEGATECALL variant is rejected by the unconditional guard rule
the changed operation also changes the Safe digest

fixtures.title: Pre-increment nonce binding
fixtures.setup: Safe nonce is N; sign valid transaction digest using N.
fixtures.action: At the guard hook, read Safe nonce N+1 and derive signed nonce as currentNonce minus one.
assertions: guard hook observes N+1 on Safe v1.4.1
using live N+1 as digest nonce fails the paired negative assertion

fixtures.title: Wrong Safe replay
fixtures.setup: Create valid attestation for Safe A and configure Safe B with same owners/nonce.
fixtures.action: Attempt use of Safe A attestation on Safe B.
assertions: Safe B has no side effect

fixtures.title: Wrong chain replay
fixtures.setup: Create valid attestation on configured Anvil chain ID.
fixtures.action: Verify or execute against a different chain ID/domain.

fixtures.title: Expired verifier signatures
fixtures.setup: Create valid attestation with short validUntil and advance timestamp past expiry.
fixtures.action: Submit Safe execution after expiration.

fixtures.title: Only one verifier signature
fixtures.setup: Threshold is 2-of-3; submit one valid active signer.
fixtures.action: Attempt execution.
assertions: policy permits the action but quorum is not met
Safe execution is not submitted while verifier quorum is below threshold

fixtures.title: Duplicate signer cannot satisfy threshold
fixtures.setup: Threshold is 2-of-3; prepare duplicate copies of one signer's signature.
fixtures.action: Submit duplicate copies as separate signature records.
assertions: Safe execution is not submitted because duplicate signer records do not reach threshold

fixtures.title: Consumed digest replay
fixtures.setup: Execute a transaction using a valid attestation, then retain the record/signatures.
fixtures.action: Attempt to reuse the same proposal/digest after successful execution.
assertions: consumed record cannot authorize a second execution
nonce advancement makes the old digest unavailable at the next Safe nonce

fixtures.title: Unknown selector
fixtures.setup: Target a contract with unknown selector and no approved decoder mapping.
fixtures.action: Run independent decoder and proposal flow.

fixtures.title: Malformed short calldata
fixtures.setup: Use calldata shorter than required selector/arguments for a known ABI.
fixtures.action: Decode and submit proposal.

fixtures.title: Trailing ambiguous calldata bytes
fixtures.setup: Use known selector with unsupported trailing bytes or ambiguous ABI encoding.
fixtures.action: Run decoder.

fixtures.title: Contract interaction target has no code
fixtures.setup: Point a contract-method interaction at an address with empty runtime code; do not use native transfer mode.
fixtures.action: Attempt decode and verifier flow.
assertions: zero code hash for EOA is not confused with native transfer

fixtures.title: Proxy implementation changes after review
fixtures.setup: Deploy supported proxy with resolver; attest implementation A address/code hash.
fixtures.action: Change proxy implementation to B while proxy runtime code hash remains stable, then execute old attestation.
assertions: proxy-specific on-chain resolver sees live B
implementation address or code hash mismatch rejects
to.codehash alone would not pass this fixture

fixtures.title: Unlimited ERC-20 approval
fixtures.setup: Decode approve(spender,uint256.max) for known token.
fixtures.action: Request verifier attestation.
assertions: unlimited allowance is not ordinary transfer

fixtures.title: NFT operator approval
fixtures.setup: Decode setApprovalForAll(operator,true) for known NFT contract.
fixtures.action: Request verifier attestation.

fixtures.title: Transfer to non-allowlisted recipient
fixtures.setup: Prepare a supported transfer to a recipient absent from active policy.
fixtures.action: Run policy and verifier decision.
assertions: decoder can describe transfer but policy denies it

fixtures.title: Transfer exceeds configured amount cap
fixtures.setup: Set transfer amount one base unit above cap.
fixtures.action: Run policy and verifier decision.

fixtures.title: Unsupported permit authorization
fixtures.setup: Submit permit-style authorization before its decoder is implemented.
fixtures.action: Run decoder.
assertions: nonce, spender, amount, and expiry are not guessed

fixtures.title: Attempt to remove guard
fixtures.setup: Current Safe has IntentLock guard installed.
fixtures.action: Submit Safe self-call setGuard(address(0)).

fixtures.title: Attempt to enable module
fixtures.setup: Safe 1.4.1 has no modules enabled.
fixtures.action: Submit Safe self-call enableModule(module).

fixtures.title: Attempt to disable module
fixtures.setup: Use a fixture module only in isolated test setup, not normal demo deployment.
fixtures.action: Submit Safe self-call disableModule(prev,module).
assertions: module administration is refused by policy

fixtures.title: Attempt to change Safe implementation
fixtures.setup: Safe proxy points to configured singleton.
fixtures.action: Submit master-copy/implementation change selector through Safe self-call.

fixtures.title: Attempt to change owner threshold
fixtures.setup: Safe has known owner set and threshold.
fixtures.action: Submit owner or threshold administration selector.
assertions: owner set and threshold remain unchanged

fixtures.title: Execute guard replacement before readyAt
fixtures.setup: Schedule allowlisted nonzero guard replacement and record exact readyAt/digest.
fixtures.action: Attempt exact scheduled execution before readyAt.
assertions: schedule remains bound to same digest and code hash

fixtures.title: Safe module execution route
fixtures.setup: Normal deployment has no enabled modules; attempt to invoke execTransactionFromModule from an unenabled address.
fixtures.action: Call Safe module execution entrypoint directly.
assertions: transaction guard is not misrepresented as module protection

fixtures.title: Registry/RPC/verifier unavailable
fixtures.setup: Make registry read unavailable or verifier quorum unreachable without changing Safe state.
fixtures.action: Attempt supported CALL execution.
assertions: client records stable error code and attempted digest

fixtures.title: Direct target runtime code hash changes after attestation
fixtures.setup: Attest a supported direct contract CALL at target code hash A.
fixtures.action: Replace or alter the local fixture target code before Safe execution.
assertions: changed runtime code is rejected before target execution

fixtures.title: Execute allowlisted guard replacement after readyAt
fixtures.setup: Schedule a valid nonzero allowlisted guard replacement; keep Safe nonce unchanged until timer is ready.
fixtures.action: Advance Anvil time to readyAt and execute the exact attested Safe digest.
assertions: Safe nonce and exact digest still match schedule
successful receipt and ChangedGuard state are recorded

fixtures.title: Cancelled guard replacement cannot execute
fixtures.setup: Schedule a valid guard replacement and cancel it through the configured Safe authority.
fixtures.action: Attempt the previously scheduled exact Safe transaction after cancellation.

fixtures.title: Untrusted caller cannot consume an attestation
fixtures.setup: Create a valid, unconsumed registry record for a Safe transaction.
fixtures.action: Call the registry consume function from an address other than the configured guard.
assertions: attestation remains available to the configured guard
attacker cannot cause denial of service

fixtures.title: Supported CALL with zero verifier attestations
fixtures.setup: Prepare a supported CALL and valid Safe owner signatures but submit no verifier attestations to the registry.
fixtures.action: Attempt Safe execution against the IntentLock-protected Safe.
assertions: decoder policy permits the proposal but no verifier quorum exists
vault and target state remain unchanged
